title: Venezuelan Quesadilla
description: A twist on the classic quesadilla, this Venezuelan version adds a layer of melted cheese and a hint of Venezuelan spices.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat.
Place a quesadilla in the skillet and sprinkle shredded cheese on half of the tortilla.
Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the cheese.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the tortilla is crispy and the cheese is melted.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2 minutes or until the other side is crispy.
Repeat with the remaining quesadillas and cheese.
Serve hot with Venezuelan spices sprinkled on top, if desired.
